addedCounterTips.reason: Use Groot's walls to break Peni's Spider-Nest. When the nest is exposed, focus it until it is destroyed; this forces Peni to rebuild and puts the nest on its full cooldown. Coordinate the wall with your team so the nest stays pressured while you clear it.

Keep Cyber-Web Snare ready for Hulk's engage and tag him with repeated web shots as he crosses the fight. The web pressure makes it harder for him to reach your backline or chase a target, especially when your team follows up on each hit.

Use Phoenix Force to dive Rocket when he is committed to healing or holding a support angle. The burst can remove him from the fight quickly; time the entry with allied pressure so his escape options are limited.

Use Phoenix Force to pressure Hela when she commits to Goddess of Death or holds a predictable angle. The burst can finish her during the ultimate sequence; coordinate the dive so she has little time to reposition.

Commit Phoenix Force onto Elsa as she channels or holds Glartrox in a fixed area. The burst can force her out of the sequence or remove her before she finishes it; call the timing so teammates can follow the same target.

Phoenix Force is effective into Omega Hurricane because its damage strips the bonus health that sustains Storm during the cast. Time the dive as she commits, then stay with your team to finish her before she can disengage.

Use Phoenix Force to pressure Jeff during It's Jeff!. The damage can strip the ultimate's bonus health, leaving him exposed while he moves through the fight. Coordinate the timing so teammates can punish the reduced health pool.

Phoenix Force can break through Peni's fortified nest setup and pressure her while she anchors it. Use the dive to damage the Spider-Nest and force Peni to abandon the position, then let teammates finish the structure or the exposed Peni.

Use Rage of Ultron as Elsa commits to Glartrox. Ultron's ultimate pressure can force her to move or break her hold on the area; call the focus target as she starts the cast so teammates can follow up.

Time It's Jeff! as Elsa commits to Glartrox. Swallow Elsa or the group around her to interrupt the setup and move the fight away from the ultimate's impact area; coordinate the cast with your team's engage.

Activate Magneto's self-shield while standing near the center of Jeff's ultimate. With tight timing, the bubble can absorb the swallow effect and negate Jeff's full displacement window; call the cast so nearby allies can position around you.

Use Gamma Barrier on yourself near the center of Jeff's ultimate as the swallow closes. The bubble can protect Hulk through the effect and nullify Jeff's full ultimate window; call the timing so teammates can use the same safe space.

Place Doppelgangers where Psylocke's Dance of the Butterfly is likely to travel. Her ultimate can be drawn toward the clones, giving your team space to avoid the real target; use Devious Exchange to reposition and keep the real Loki safe.

Time Namor's bubble to cover an ally as Iron Man begins Invincible Pulse Cannon. Place the protection over the target in the blast lane before the projectile lands, then call the team to spread out of the remaining danger area.
Keep Namor's bubble ready for Magneto's Meteor M. Cover the target as Magneto descends so the protection absorbs the impact and helps the team survive the landing zone.

Use Peni's web to intercept the incoming ultimate projectile when Iron Man begins Invincible Pulse Cannon. Place the web across the firing lane before impact so allies behind it have cover and time to reposition.
Use Peni's web to intercept the incoming ultimate projectile when Magneto begins Meteor M. Place the web across the impact lane as he descends, giving allies behind it a chance to avoid the blast.

Enter Culling Turret form or activate Final Judgement before Jeff's swallow connects. Punisher's crowd-control immunity during either state can prevent the displacement and let him continue firing through the ultimate window.

Jeff's ultimate and Sue's Invisible Boundary both have a 10-metre radius. Use It's Jeff! to pressure the edge of Sue's zone: enemies must leave the area to avoid being swallowed, which can break the protection and expose the team.

Hold Gamma Barrier until Black Panther commits to your backline. Place it around your team immediately after his first dash; denying the damage during his follow-up can remove the hit he needs for a dash reset and leave him exposed for a counter-engage.

Use Gamma Barrier to protect your team while Iron Fist spends his block/parry. As soon as the defensive window ends, use Hulk's exile to remove him from the fight; refresh the barrier when he returns and let your team focus him.
Keep Gamma Barrier ready for Daredevil's entry. Let him spend his block first, then use Hulk's exile to remove him from the fight; reapply the barrier when he returns and call the focus target.
Use Gamma Barrier to protect the target as Captain America commits his jump. Meet the landing with Hulk's close-range control and keep pressure on him while your team focuses the same target.

Iron Fist is a strong peel pick into dive tanks because his fast punches deal sustained damage on a short cooldown. Stay attached to Venom after he swings in; use the fifth punch or kick to knock him off his route and interrupt the swing. Dive tanks are often separated from allied healing once they commit, so Iron Fist can keep pressure on them as they retreat. Wolverine remains stronger into a front-to-back tank line because his grab can kidnap a frontline target; Iron Fist excels at staying on mobile divers. One Iron Fist can pressure both dive tanks in a double-dive composition.

Use Iron Fist's mobility to meet Angela as she dives the backline. His fifth punch and kick can knock her off her dash route and create a window for the team to focus her; keep close enough to follow if she tries to retreat.

Stay close to Captain America's landing route and use Iron Fist's fast punches to keep pressure on him. The fifth punch or kick can knock him off his jump and interrupt the engage, giving your backline time to regroup.

Use Squirrel Girl's bouncing projectiles to break Peni's mines from range. Keep firing into the minefield as Peni sets up; the repeated hits clear her traps and help build Acorn Rain charge while she tries to reposition.

When Adam links allies with Soul Bond, Emma gains beam charge faster each time she attacks a bonded target, with the gain increasing by the number of linked allies. Focus the bonded group during the link window to build her beam quickly and pressure Adam's clustered team.
